file: 260 Jimothy the Raccoon Is in Video Games Now.mp4

lines.t: This is Jimothy, the round raccoon that broke the internet. And now he's in video games.

full.credit: Clips: HAPP - Story; ViralHog; Casual Geographic; KTLA 5 (YouTube)

lines.t: In July, a woman in Seattle filmed him, and said he just looked like a Jimothy. Millions of views later, he was everywhere.

full.credit: Clips: HAPP - Story; ViralHog; Casual Geographic; KTLA 5 (YouTube)

lines.t: Then gaming adopted him. Guild Wars 2 added him as a pet. Blizzard and RuneScape made tributes. There are Skyrim and Stardew Valley mods.

full.credit: Clips: HAPP - Story; ViralHog; Casual Geographic; KTLA 5 (YouTube)

lines.t: He even got an honorary degree, and his own night at a Mariners game.

full.credit: Clips: HAPP - Story; ViralHog; Casual Geographic; KTLA 5 (YouTube)
